data.narrative:
Smack Technologies is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Andy Markoff (ex-MARSOC and Palantir) and Clint Alanis (20+ years Marine special operations), having raised $32M to date. The peer universe consists of 10 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $32M total raised as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, implies $64M. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comp set yields $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $3.0B; sample peers in Series B include Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Castelion and Defense Unicorns each at $1.0B.

Triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $54M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $532M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Smack will command early-stage or scaling-stage multiples within the defense sector. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively; peer comps suggest meaningfully higher values if the company's capabilities and market traction align with later-stage cohort profiles. Founder pedigree and sector tailwinds support the upside case, though limited operating history and product maturity remain key de-risking items.
